newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-BENFICA'S HELDER SET TO JOIN DEPORTIVO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BENFICA'S HELDER SET TO JOIN DEPORTIVO.

text.p: Benfica's Portuguese international Helder Cristovao said he hoped to sign a five-year contract with Spain's Deportivo de Coruna after medical tests in Spain on Thursday.
According to press reports, the deal will cost the Spanish side around 750 million escudos ($five million).

Helder, a central defender, will join Guimaraes goalkeeper Nuno Santo at the northern Spanish club which has long been popular with Brazilian and Portuguese players because the local Galician dialect is similar to Portuguese.
His departure means Benfica, currently second in the Portuguese first division, will have lost two first team defenders in quick succession.
Earlier this month Dimas Teixeira moved to Italian champions Juventus.
